name: com.mutualmobile.barricade.activity.BarricadeActivity
description: Mutual Mobile’s Barricade mock-response library opens this panel when its optional shake shortcut detects a shake. The panel lists configured API endpoints, lets developers choose a saved response, and provides a setting for the overall response delay.
disableEffect: The shake shortcut can no longer open the mock-response panel, and an app that still tries to launch it may fail.
